colorInput.title: Color picker
colorInput.lead: A native picker whose entire clickable field shows the selected color, with a contrasting hex value. Use it wherever a form edits a color.
colorInput.label: Row color
colorInput.note: Import ColorInput from @boffmedia/ui and wrap it in Field for its label, hint and error. It forwards its ref and native input attributes; size=sm matches compact toolbars. The selected color stays visible with the picker closed.

tierLists.itemEditorNote: TierListTemplateItemEditor extracts the repeated item form. Existing artwork starts collapsed; new items start expanded. The disclosure keeps native fields mounted for validation. Edit, collapse or remove this local sample, then restore it. An optional onUpload callback enables image uploads in the host.
tierLists.controlsLead: Reusable source search, assignment progress, recoverable empty states and expandable interaction help.
tierLists.controlsNote: TierListSourcePanel is controlled and accepts cards or a drop zone as children plus optional controls. Progress counts unique movable items. Try Show all items, then search for a missing name to see filter recovery. TierListInstructions explains mouse, touch and keyboard input. Both are used by every embedded board and the starting-placement editor.
tierLists.lockedBoardLead: A compact working Fire Emblem example: four locked Lords and two freely assignable characters.
tierLists.lockedBoardNote: DragCard.dragDisabled changes its affordance while the host disables the drag sensor; click actions remain available. Its status slot supports lock and assignment markers. Lords expose their lock in the assignment dialog and cannot leave their route. Tialla and Peter can appear in several routes; duplicates within the same route are rejected. Clear and Reset retain the Lords.
tierLists.dragLead: Shared visual controls in @boffmedia/ui. The host binds its drag sensors and decides placements; the controls contain no tier-list rules.
tierLists.dragSample: Card, lifted preview, insertion slot and destination
tierLists.dragNote: Bind drag listeners to the whole DragCard button and use its click action for menus. MediaCardContent shares square artwork and a centered, compact two-line caption across cards, overlays, insertion slots and editor previews. showLabel hides the caption. DragCard has no grip marker by default. DragPreview belongs in the host overlay; DragPlaceholder occupies the predicted destination and shifts neighboring cards before dropping. Forward its drop ref to keep hovering stable. DragTarget highlights the full destination. The boards below demonstrate the real interactions.
tierLists.exclusiveLead: An embedded controlled TierList. Moving a card removes its previous placement. Edit the list heading, rename rows from their gear menu, or enable the optional centered count badges. Drag from the image or name, or tap to assign.
tierLists.multiLead: The same component with multi placement and a persistent source pool. Assign one card to several rows; clearing one leaves the others intact. This example has its own editable heading and presentation preferences.
tierLists.boardNote: Import TierList and TierListDisplayControls from @/features/tier-list. Supply template, instance, items and onChange; display preferences use shared Toggle controls and affect both the live presentation and PNG capture. Hiding editing controls removes the rail and empty-row hints while cards remain draggable. Cards always omit grip markers. Placement mode stays in the template. renderItem, renderRowHeader, sourceControls and summary customize presentation. Gear/up/down reuse IconButton and Menu iconOnly. All/Assigned filters include ranked cards. These examples keep independent state in memory without storage or API writes.
tierLists.collectionNote: The Fortune’s Weave preset reuses this board, editor and appearance controls with 50 characters across Cai, Dietrich, Theodora and Leda’s routes. Each lord is locked to their own route and stays out of Available items; the other characters can join several routes. Portraits use the existing public asset structure, with pre-timeskip artwork for the lords. Edit preset in the catalog creates a reusable copy. TierListStartingPlacementsEditor reuses the real board to edit defaults; Clear leaves route leaders in place and Reset restores all starting assignments.
tierLists.editorLead: The reusable editor shares the same schema, ColorInput, Field, Panel and other library controls. Customize its rows, rules and items.
tierLists.editorNote: TierListTemplateEditor accepts a template and an asynchronous onSave. Inject an imageStorage adapter to enable uploads. This example acknowledges save in memory and does not upload files or publish a list.

icons.description: The complete inventory of the icon registry shared by the web app, desktop app and tools.
